Nina (CSM): FYI - AtriaHealth usage cratered ~60% overnight. Their ML lead resigned last Friday; procurement asked for vendor cost compars. Renewal ~5w out. Need a fast triage and a retention play. :warning:
Theo (CS Ops): On it. Do we know whether keys are valid or if they hit any throttles?
Nina (CSM): I tried the admin console, tenant shows last activity 3 days ago. No config changes recorded. Champion had been driving inference tuning.
Rita (Solutions Eng): Could be a token rotation or IP allowlist lockdown from their infra team. Quick check to run from their environment: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ATRIA" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/status``` If 401/403 -> token issue. If 429 -> throttling.
statusbot: [auto] 2025-02-14T02:10:45Z - edge errors spike (us-east) - spike window 02:08-02:17 UTC - 980 requests affected.
Theo (CS Ops): I pulled gateway logs for tenant atria-corp: there was a cluster of 403s starting 02:05 UTC and a small burst of 503s during the edge incident. Looks like token rejected then transient gateway blip.
Sam (AE): Procurement is already seeing a demo from CompetitorX next Tue. They flagged "lower ops" and a plugin that hooks into their ETL. We need to keep them engaged. If it's purely config we can schedule a 30m triage, show a quick perf delta.
Nina (CSM): OK propose: 1) Offer 7-day Dedicated trial extension 2) Immediate triage session (30m) to fix keys/allowlist 3) Provide benchmark doc comparing p95 latency + token cost. Thoughts?
Rita (Solutions Eng): Agree. I'll prepare a one-pager with steps to validate keys and enable KV caching and batching. Also include a simple benchmark script they can run in their env: ```python
import requests
h={"Authorization":"Bearer $ATRIA"}
resp=requests.get('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage', headers=h)
print(resp.status_code, resp.text[:200])
```
Theo (CS Ops): I'll flag tenant for no auto-billing and ensure their Dedicated trial has capacity reserved if we extend. Also adding a short-lived support token for them to run tests if their keys are rotated.
Sam (AE): I'll reach out to procurement with an executive summary and a calendar invite for triage. I'll also offer a joint session with Solutions Eng and Product to demo the plugin integration patterns (to counter the "lower ops" pitch).
Nina (CSM): Action list: @Rita one-pager + quick script (ETA: today EOD). @Theo gating/billing hold + support token (ETA: 2h). @Sam outreach + procurement sync (ETA: today). I'll escalate to our exec sponsor if no response by EOD tomorrow.
Rita (Solutions Eng): Draft checklist posted: 1) Confirm token validity (401/403) 2) Confirm IP allowlist and VPN/firewall rules 3) Run simple usage curl/python check 4) If 429 -> check tenant throttles & request quota bump 5) Enable KV cache & batching flags on trial 6) Collect request IDs & attach logs for triage
Theo (CS Ops): Noted. Also: if they request a cost comparison, we'll supply an apples-to-apples tokenized cost sheet; don't promise pricing changes without finance sign-off.
Nina (CSM): Great. I'll wait for procurement reply. If we fix keys/burst and show improved latency/cost, we can propose a 6mo reserved pilot to lock renewal. :muscle:
